title: Thursday · Nevermoor, Halloween art, Student Vote and Career
arrival: Settle in and answer attendance before handing in forms. Today we have time for Nevermoor, Halloween art, Student Vote and finishing Career.
note: Thursday protects Nevermoor and Halloween decoration time because neither happened on Wednesday. Start Nevermoor from the actual book or audio bookmark, not an assumed chapter. Keep library 9:20–9:35, snack 10:20, recess 10:35–10:50, PE 11:10–11:50 and lunch 11:50–12:35. After a brief quiet reset, use 12:45–12:50 for voting instructions and 12:50–1:10 for Student Vote. The 12:50 school voting start is confirmed. Then use the confirmed afternoon computers from 1:10–2:00 to finish the Career task already underway. No extra assessment is added to voting. Maths can resume from the actual classroom stopping point when there is room; do not assume Wednesday’s prime-factorization lesson was completed or move ahead automatically. Unfinished decorations can continue next week. Friday October 23 is a non-instructional day.

blocks.title: Arrival and attendance
blocks.notes: Attendance before form collection. Preview Nevermoor, art, library, PE and the afternoon Career finish block.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at today’s plan and get ready for Nevermoor.

blocks.title: Nevermoor · read, listen and respond
blocks.notes: Protect the reading missed on Wednesday. Find the actual book or audio bookmark and briefly recall only the last part actually read. Do not assume a chapter or story event. Read or listen for about 20 minutes, then say, draw or write an idea supported by one character or setting detail. Mark the new stopping point before library.
blocks.firstAction: Find where our class actually stopped in Nevermoor and get ready to listen or read.
studentSteps: Listen or read from our actual stopping point.
Notice one character or setting detail.
Say, draw or write an idea and the detail that supports it.
Mark where we stop and keep one question for next time.
blocks.firstActionKo: 지난번에 읽다가 멈춘 곳을 찾고 이야기를 듣거나 읽을 준비를 하세요.

blocks.title: Prepare for library
blocks.notes: Save the actual reading bookmark and allow a calm transition to library.
blocks.firstAction: Mark our Nevermoor stopping point and get your library book.
blocks.firstActionKo: 읽다가 멈춘 곳을 표시하고 도서관 책을 준비하세요.

blocks.title: Library · book exchange
blocks.notes: Established Thursday book exchange; return to class by 9:35.
blocks.firstAction: Bring your library book and follow the exchange routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 도서관 책을 가져오고 정해진 순서대로 반납과 대출을 하세요.

blocks.title: Halloween decorations · plan and create
blocks.notes: This is protected art time carried over from Wednesday, not an assumption that decorations have already begun. Show the actual choices and available materials. Demonstrate one safe making step, then let students choose a decoration and sketch a simple plan. Use line, shape, colour or pattern deliberately; students can explain one choice. Circulate for help with the next step. At 10:15, stop for safe storage and a short tidy so snack starts on time. Keep work and materials ready to continue after recess; completion today is not required.
blocks.firstAction: Look at the decoration choices and watch the first making step.
studentSteps: Choose a decoration and make a quick sketch or plan.
Use the demonstrated safe steps to start making it.
Choose a line, shape, colour or pattern on purpose.
Keep your pieces together and save your place before snack.
blocks.firstActionKo: 장식 선택지를 살펴보고 첫 번째 만들기 시범을 보세요.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Halloween decorations · continue and tidy
blocks.notes: Continue the morning decoration rather than introduce a new task. Help students complete one manageable next step and explain a design choice. Begin tidy-up at 11:05: store wet or unfinished work safely, return tools and clear tables. Be ready for PE at 11:10. Any remaining art can continue in the flexible finish block or next week.
blocks.firstAction: Find your decoration and continue from your saved place.
studentSteps: Continue one clear next step.
Show or explain one design choice.
At the tidy-up signal, store your work safely and prepare for PE.
blocks.firstActionKo: 만들던 장식을 찾아 멈춘 곳부터 계속하세요.

blocks.title: Physical and Health Education · shared gym
blocks.notes: Choose a familiar cooperative passing/target activity after checking space, equipment and access. Warm up, practise controlled movements at a suitable distance, then play a short challenge and cool down. Adjust equipment, distance or role so everyone participates.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the safety directions and choose a way to join.
studentSteps: Practise a controlled pass or target movement.
Help everyone get an active turn.
Name one action that helped the group.
blocks.firstActionKo: 안전 수칙을 듣고 참여할 방법을 고르세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet reset
blocks.notes: Keep this a brief calm transition after lunch. Quiet non-reading choices are available. Prepare for the Career finish block without starting another lesson.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or a calm seated activity.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 자리에 앉아서 쉬기 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: Student Vote · get ready
blocks.notes: Briefly explain the school voting routine using the supplied sample ballot or official directions. Show how to mark and handle a ballot without suggesting a choice. Keep choices private, allow questions about the process, and add no quiz, written reflection or assessment. The school voting start is confirmed for 12:50.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to how we will mark and handle our ballot privately.
studentSteps: Ask any questions about the voting process.
Follow the school instructions and respect everyone’s private choice.
blocks.firstActionKo: 비밀 투표 방법과 투표용지 사용 안내를 들으세요.

blocks.title: Student Vote
blocks.notes: The school voting start is confirmed for 12:50. Allow this 20-minute block for the actual provincial Student Vote and return to Career afterward. Confirm the location and materials before moving the class. Follow the school and CIVIX procedure, keep ballot choices secret, and do not collect a political preference as assessment evidence. Registration, school ballot district and full candidate roster are not verified by this day plan.
blocks.firstAction: Follow your teacher’s directions for our voting time and keep your choice private.
studentSteps: Wait for the school voting directions.
Cast your ballot independently and privately.
Return calmly and get ready to continue Career.
blocks.firstActionKo: 선생님의 투표 안내를 따르고 자신의 선택은 비밀로 하세요.

blocks.title: Career · finish our task on computers
blocks.notes: Afternoon computers are confirmed. Finish the Career task already begun; do not introduce a new assignment or assume everyone has reached the same point. Start by reopening the existing work and naming what remains. Use the original task directions and success criteria, then improve or complete the work. Check progress before transitions and leave a clear next-step note whenever pausing. Save work in its existing location and show the teacher what is finished. Submit only if the original task instructions require it; do not add a new upload or home deadline. If voting moves or a student needs more time, save a clear next step for the next suitable class block.
blocks.firstAction: Open your existing Career work and identify what you still need to finish.
studentSteps: Use the original task directions to choose your next step.
Finish or improve the work you have already started.
Check it against the original success criteria.
Save your work and show your teacher what you finished or what remains.
blocks.titleKo: 진로 교육 · 컴퓨터로 하던 과제 마무리하기
blocks.firstActionKo: 기존 진로 과제를 열고 무엇을 더 해야 하는지 확인하세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Keep routine cleanup around 2:00; move unfinished learning forward.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Classroom community
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass. Name a small next step for our next school day; Friday is non-instructional.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for our next school day.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: The Student Vote start is confirmed for 12:50. If voting takes longer than the planned 20 minutes, shorten the Career block and save unfinished work for the next suitable class time; keep the 2:35 dismissal.
If computer access fails, use the original Career directions and available notes to draft or revise the unfinished part on paper. Save a clear next step for the next computer session.
If a decoration material is missing, use an available paper-based choice or sketch a design. Keep the protected art time and do not require a purchase.
If the class book or audio is unavailable, use choice reading with an idea and supporting detail. Do not invent Nevermoor progress.
For familiar prime-factorization practice only, use the existing companion at ./math-prime-factorization.html. Start from what was actually taught and multiply prime end factors back to check.
Friday October 23 is a non-instructional day. Carry unfinished work to the next suitable class time, not a new home deadline.
